title: Income Annuities State Withholding on Reissued Installments
content:
State tax is withheld from a reissued Ashgrove Income Annuities installment only when federal tax is withheld from it and federal tax was withheld from the contract's installments falling due in the twelve months before the reissue. Then it is withheld on the taxable part, rounded to the cent:

> at the state flat rate of **5% (0.05)** for a contract issued in Iowa, Minnesota, North Carolina or Vermont; and at the alternative state rate of **4% (0.04)** for a contract issued in Delaware, New York or Oklahoma.

Otherwise no state tax is withheld from the reissued installment.

The twelve-month condition is met when the federal tax withheld on the installments issued for payment dates in the twelve months before the reissue totals more than zero.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical, taxable part $812.50).**

- Iowa contract, federal tax withheld from the reissue and from earlier installments in the prior twelve months: $40.63 (40.625 rounded to the cent).
- New York contract, same conditions: $32.50.
- Iowa contract whose owner elected no federal withholding: no state tax.
- Delaware contract with federal tax on the reissue but none on any installment due in the prior twelve months: no state tax.
